summary: Nordic goalscorer grading + history sort fixes verified end-to-end via 15/15 pytest cases (backend only, per request). /api/picks/history?days=30 returns 200 with picks correctly sorted by event_time desc (zero out-of-order pairs across all rows), and correctly excludes hide_from_main_board, no_bet, excluded_from_history, and status=void. All 6 WON picks from the 2026-07-12/13 FanDuel screenshot (Kristian Lien 07-13, Robbie Ure, Isak Bjerkebo, Paulos Abraham, Erik Botheim, Mikkel Ladefoged 07-12) now show status=won in history. Both LOST picks (Kasper Høgh, Peter Christiansen 07-12) show status=lost with no won duplicates. grading_validator.py imports cleanly (exposes verify_recent_goalscorer_grades + grading_validator_loop). stuck_pick_reaper.py imports cleanly with _STUCK_HOURS=72. soccer_espn_settle._grade_pick contains the Nordic-primary branch: `is_nordic` matches nor.1/swe.1/den.1/fin.1 + allsvenskan/eliteserien/superligaen/veikkausliiga and dispatches to soccer_fotmob_settle.settle_soccer_leg with 'if is_nordic or result is None' guarding the call. /api/picks/today?lite=true returned 200 with a populated picks list and IDs present — on_main_board_at bulk update_many stamp path (picks_routes.py:1662) is reachable (fire-and-forget so response body doesn't echo the stamp).
critical_code_review_comments: picks_routes.py:672 correctly sorts by event_time desc — verified against live payload (0 out-of-order pairs).
picks_routes.py:613-614 excludes hide_from_main_board / no_bet — verified against every returned pick.
picks_routes.py:1662-1666 uses update_many with {on_main_board_at: {$exists: False}} guard so first-surface timestamp is preserved across refreshes. Sound.
soccer_espn_settle.py:367-390 correctly makes FotMob PRIMARY for Nordic (not just fallback) — logs a warning on ESPN↔FotMob disagreement and returns FotMob's answer.
grading_validator.py cross-checks recent grades against FotMob independently; verified module contract.

It matches picks by last-name substring with Nordic-character folding (Høgh↔Hogh) so it survives selection-string variations.
